design_rationale:
WORKLOG — task 1 of driver_account_holds_and_deactivations (Wayfare Mobility, category driver). Round 2 (rework after the policy-task audit); every figure below is the output of the verification run recorded at the end.

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1: prerequisite_problems 3, problems 4, factor_counts [5, 6, 5, 4]. Assignment: driver_ext_temporary_permit_acceptance 6 factors, driver_ext_inspection_validity 5, driver_ext_registration_hold_start 5, driver_ext_cancellation_warning_sequence 4. Task 0 holds the lapse allowance, binder and temporary license policies; this task claims driver_ext_cancellation_warning_sequence (tool record_cancellation_warning_d72ae138), driver_ext_registration_hold_start (tool place_registration_hold_154e4b50), driver_ext_inspection_validity (tool record_inspection_validity_ad704ee2) and driver_ext_temporary_permit_acceptance (user tool upload_temporary_permit_14d2792d). Every extended policy of the difficulty is claimed exactly once.

[Why this is a good test] Darnell asks only to file his temporary permit. The 44 days that land depend on: the permit rule's two waiting sentences (the inspection expiry date must carry the latest inspection upload; the agreement must already carry any registration hold whose grace has run out); the registration-grace rule's waiting sentence (every breaching rating review must carry its warning); a warning number of 6 — the cycle rule recounts because the last warning is 6 months old (continuing from its stored 7 would give 9), over the 24-month Black window, less Gold forgiveness, plus severity; a registration grace of 6 — once that warning is on record the grace clock runs from the 2026-09-13 second notice, so the hold is owed from 2026-09-26; an inspection validity of 138 days (clock from the old expiry 2026-10-12); and a permit figure of 44 whose takeover clock counts from the old permit's expiry 2026-10-15. Depth: warning -> hold -> permit plus the inspection branch. Breadth: standing record (reviews, seven warnings, notices, uploads), agreement dates and counts, the earnings account (cross-category), and two earlier writes of the same call.

[Problem-tree card] Root driver_ext_temporary_permit_acceptance (on_request, user tool upload_temporary_permit_14d2792d). Edges (state form, value_input):
 E1 driver_ext_temporary_permit_acceptance -> driver_ext_inspection_validity: gate short_doc_adj; sentence (negated): "The temporary permit acceptance days are not worked out until the vehicle inspection expiry date on the agreement carries the validity of the latest inspection uploaded to the standing record."; false at opening: inspection_expiry_date 2026-10-12 while the 2026-09-29 inspection upload is unrecorded; resolved by record_inspection_validity_ad704ee2, the only write setting the inspection expiry from an inspection upload. Derivation: sentence + records + the inspection rule ('support records it, and the vehicle inspection expiry date on the agreement becomes the inspection date plus the inspection validity days') -> record the inspection.
 E2 driver_ext_temporary_permit_acceptance -> driver_ext_registration_hold_start: gate standing_adj; sentence (affirmative 'Before ... must'): "Before the temporary permit acceptance days are worked out, the agreement must already carry the document hold owed for a vehicle registration whose grace days have run out."; false at opening: status active, hold_reason none, registration expired 2026-09-20; resolved by place_registration_hold_154e4b50, the only write placing a registration hold. Derivation: sentence + records + the registration rule -> compute the grace, find the start date arrived, place the hold.
 E3 driver_ext_registration_hold_start -> driver_ext_cancellation_warning_sequence: gate clock_shift; sentence (affirmative 'only after'): "The registration grace days are fixed only after the standing record carries the quality warning owed for every rating review that found the cancellation rate above the level's threshold."; false at opening: review 2026-09-25 at 7.4% > 6.0% has no warning (latest warning 2026-03-30); resolved by record_cancellation_warning_d72ae138, the only write recording a cancellation warning. Derivation: sentence + records + base cancellation standard ('Every breach is recorded as a cancellation warning') and the warning-sequence rule -> record the warning.
 Directions: E1 negated, E2/E3 affirmative. Topological order driver_ext_cancellation_warning_sequence -> driver_ext_registration_hold_start -> driver_ext_inspection_validity -> driver_ext_temporary_permit_acceptance (driver_ext_inspection_validity commutes with the first two; proved by run). value_input edges 3 >= max(3-1,1). Deletion runs: skip inspection -> permit 38; skip hold -> permit 49; skip warning -> grace 13 (hold not yet due).

[Base-invariant card] driver_ext_cancellation_warning_sequence subject driver_quality_warning: driver_rating_standard gate active_agreement (status active, 500 rated trips >= 100 — satisfied at step 6, which is also why the warning must precede the hold) + driver_cancellation_standard policy scope; no overwrite; escalation checked: no warning within 90 days of the breach (last 2026-03-30) and fewer than three breaches inside 180 days however the window is anchored, so a warning and no hold/deactivation. The cycle rule's fresh-cycle tier numbers a first warning one, matching the base gloss of notice_sequence. driver_ext_registration_hold_start subject driver_hold: driver_cancellation_standard, driver_document_compliance, driver_background_recheck_rules, driver_safety_rules — no gate applies, all policy scope; overwrite of 'On the day after a required document expires ... goes on hold' by the registration-grace sentence. driver_ext_inspection_validity subject driver_document_update: driver_document_compliance policy scope; overwrite of the upload sentence. driver_ext_temporary_permit_acceptance subjects submit+update: driver_document_compliance gate not_closed (on hold after step 8, never closed); overwrite of the upload sentence. No time gate applies.

[Business-object card] One agreement c097ee82-bb2f-4920-b395-3fe599c602c6. Warning object = review 2026-09-25 (7.4%). Prior warnings in the 24-month window: 2024-10-21, 2025-02-03, 2025-05-19, 2025-09-02, 2025-12-15, 2026-03-30; near miss 2024-07-08 (26 months; counting it gives 7). Latest earlier warning 2026-03-30 carries number 7 (the continuation trap). Registration object = latest registration upload (expiry 2026-09-20) with notices 2026-08-21 and 2026-09-13; near-miss upload 2023-09-19 (36 months; counting it gives 8). Inspection upload 2026-09-29; near-miss notice 2024-04-05 (29 months; gives 128). Permit uploads 2024-10-10, 2025-10-08; near miss 2023-09-28 (36 months; counting it gives three uploads, +5, and 47).

[Factor cards — each method factor's three tiers compute three different formula shapes (round 3: the permit takeover's second tier now takes off the uncovered days beyond 14, at most 10, instead of repeating the first tier's expression)]
 driver_ext_cancellation_warning_sequence: cycle window Black 24 -> 6 earlier warnings (baseline 12 -> 2; 2); cycle rule (method) recount instead of continuation (9); Gold forgiveness 2 (earnings, cross-difficulty) (8); severity 1.4 points +1 (5); fall-back 8; gold 6.
 driver_ext_registration_hold_start: tenure +6 (1); 3 late registration notices -2 (8); Gold AND 4.91 >= 4.80 +4 (multi-source, cross-difficulty) (2); 2 registration uploads +4 (2); grace clock (method) from the second notice, -7 (13); fall-back 1; gold 6.
 driver_ext_inspection_validity (unchanged from round 1): age 4 -15 (153); 2 late inspection notices -10 (148); 756.7 yearly trips -10 (148); registration lapsed -20 (158); clock from the 2026-10-12 expiry +13 (125); fall-back 180; gold 138.
 driver_ext_temporary_permit_acceptance: permit takeover (method) from the old permit's expiry, +14 (30); rating 4.91 +6 (38); one short document -6 (50); check 206 days +3 (41); 2 permit uploads +2 (42); on hold -5 (49); fall-back 30; gold 44.

[Seed rows and why] customers (identity); driver_agreements (dates and counts); earnings_accounts (Wayfare Pro Gold for Q4 2026, set 2026-10-01 from Q3: the last review before the evaluation, 2026-09-25, shows 7.4% cancellations and 4.91 — within Gold's 8.00% and 4.80 gates, outside Platinum's 6.00%; no ledger is seeded, balance 0.00 and points 0 — no trips since Monday 2026-09-28 04:00, the previous week paid on Tuesday). Pro history used for the seeded warning numbers: Gold every quarter from Q3 2024 through Q4 2025 (each evaluation's latest review within Gold's gates and outside Platinum's), Silver for Q1 2026 (a one-level drop at the 2026-01-01 evaluation, the quarter's points being below Gold's 600 — points are not on record), Gold again from Q2 2026. Standing record: 7 cancellation warnings, each matching a breaching review on the same day, spaced 104-106 days, numbers [1, 1, 1, 3, 3, 4, 7] — each the cycle number of its own day under the cycle rule (fresh cycle, then recounts over the Black 24-month window with the forgiveness of the status then held); the 2026-06-26 review (no breach) and the 2026-09-25 breach review; registration uploads and notices; inspection notices and the unrecorded inspection upload; permit uploads and the 2026-09-15 notice; insurance and license uploads; recheck 2026-03-09. Automatic clauses: no other lapse; after the call the registration hold stays (registration still lapsed); no safety reports; no rating action (4.91 >= 4.85).

[Persona] Unchanged in round 2: Darnell opens with the permit request only; phone 7205550193 to locate, card 9157 to verify, birth date as fallback; facts only when asked (days off since Monday, inspection passed and uploaded 2026-09-29, registration sticker not arrived, old one ran out 2026-09-20, turned down airport runs); passive reactions to a warning, a hold and the inspection; runs the handed-over upload with the given values and reads back the date; closes. No extra asks.

[Reachability] locate -> verify -> read agreement, standing record, earnings account -> warning -> hold -> inspection -> hand-over upload. All arguments computed (notice_sequence, grace_days, validity_days, accepted_days) or copied from lookups (agreement id, 7.4 from the review, 2026-09-20 from the registration upload, 2026-09-29 from the inspection upload). One frozen_time.

[Most likely mistakes] continuing the numbering from the stored 7 (8 or 9) or counting 12 months (2); placing the hold with grace 13 (warning not yet recorded — and then not yet due) or with the base day-after rule (1); recording the inspection for 180 days; computing the permit on the opening world (38 with no inspection, 49 with no hold) or from the upload day (30); counting the windowed-out rows; lifting the hold (registration still lapsed).

[Standard solution] warning (7.4, 6) -> hold from 2026-09-26 (expiry 2026-09-20, grace 6) -> inspection to 2027-02-14 (2026-09-29, 138) -> Darnell uploads the permit with 44 -> permit on file to 2026-11-14.

[Revision log — round 2]
 T1-1 symptom: the warning number equalled the latest stored number plus one. Root cause: the old rule counted in a way that tracked the stored numbers. Change: the cycle rule now chooses continuation (stored number + 1 + severity), recount, or a fresh cycle by the age of the latest warning; this warning is a recount, and the seeded numbers were recomputed under the rule with the recorded Pro history; continuation gives 9, the stored number plus one gives 8, the answer is 6.
 T1-2 symptom: Pro Platinum for Q4 2026 was unreachable from the 7.4% review. Change: the account holds Wayfare Pro Gold (reachable), and forgiveness and the Pro-and-rating ladder were re-tiered (Platinum and up 3, Gold 2, else 0; Silver/Gold with rating >= 4.80 -> +4) so the factors still bite. O-1 (rate-and-rounding methods, mandatory per coordinator): the warning's tenure method was removed (replaced by the cycle rule); the registration grace's standing method became the grace-clock rule (clock from the second notice, the first notice, or the expiry); the permit's standing ladder became an honest parameter (-10/-5/0) and the permit gained a takeover-clock method, its old-permit ladder dropped to stay at six factors. O-8: the warning policy's basis now quotes the factor sentences. O-T1-a: the warning and registration near misses now move the result.
 Re-run: warning 4 -> 6, grace 5 -> 6 (hold start 2026-09-25 -> 2026-09-26), inspection 138 unchanged, permit 24 -> 44. Propagation: seed (Pro, warning numbers), computations, every changed call's tracing, read objectives/necessity, contract effects and seed checks, closure edges/flips/order/load-bearing, this dossier.

[Revision log — round 3]
 G2-1 / R2-T1-1 symptom: the permit takeover's first two tiers computed the same expression (days from the upload day to the old expiry). Change: tier 2 (permit expired at least relapse_days before the upload) now counts the cover from the upload day and takes off only the uncovered days beyond relapse_days, at most lapse_cap_days; tier 1 adds the days to the old expiry; tier 3 changes nothing. With the permit on file at 2026-09-10 tier 2 gives 23 where the old shared expression gave 9; this world takes tier 1 (+14), so gold 44 and every sensitivity are unchanged. The order sentence was reworded ('adds days to them or takes days off them as it states').
 R2-T1-2: the permit-upload near miss figure corrected from 49 to 47 (three uploads, +5 instead of +2: 33 + 14).
 Propagation: the permit factor trace, this dossier.

[Verification] Scratch run (handling-time evaluation with check_compute's build_env/eval_compute, real tool replay): D 6 (baseline 8), E 6 (baseline 1), F 138 (baseline 180), G 44 (baseline 30); order F,D,E,G -> same values and identical terminal DB; skip D -> E 13; skip E -> G 49; skip F -> G 38. Gate record in the final report.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules, the three lookups and Darnell's lines: the warning rule and base escalation give a warning numbered 6; the registration rule then gives 6 and an arrived start date; the inspection rule 138; the permit rule 44. No value sits on a tier boundary (6 months since the last warning against 3 and 12, 1.4 points, 3 and 2 notices, 756.7 trips, 13 days ahead, 14 days left, 206 days, 4.91 vs 4.90 and 4.80).
user_scenario: You are Darnell Whitfield, 45, who drives a 2022 Lexus ES 300h hybrid on the Wayfare Black agreement in Denver and has done Black work since 2021. You are courteous, a little formal, and you like to get paperwork squared away early. Your Colorado for-hire permit expires on October 15. You renewed it with the Public Utilities Commission on Tuesday, and they gave you a temporary permit receipt to use until the new permit is mailed. You call Wayfare support this morning and open with something like: "Good morning. My for-hire permit expires on the fifteenth; I renewed it on Tuesday and the PUC gave me a temporary permit receipt until the new one comes. I want the temporary permit on file before the old one runs out." When the agent asks how to find your account you give your mobile number, 7205550193. Only when the agent asks you to verify your identity do you give the last four digits of your card, 9157; if they want one more detail you give your date of birth, 1981-08-02. You do not know any reference numbers. If the agent asks whether you are driving this week, you say you have taken a few days off since Monday. If the agent asks about your vehicle inspection, you say you passed the inspection at the partner station on Tuesday, September 29, and uploaded the form in the app the same afternoon. If the agent asks about your vehicle registration, you say the renewal sticker has not arrived and the old registration ran out on September 20. If the agent asks about your cancellations, you say you turned down a run of long airport pickups last month. You are fine with the agent taking care of whatever their rules require on your account for this; you do not ask why beyond what the agent chooses to explain. If the agent tells you a cancellation warning is being recorded, you sigh and say you understand. If the agent tells you your account is going on hold because of the registration, you say that is fair and that you will not drive until the sticker comes. If the agent tells you your inspection is now on file, you say good. When the agent hands the temporary permit upload over to you and tells you exactly what to enter, you run it yourself with exactly the values the agent gives you and then read back the permit expiry date it shows. If that date is earlier than you expected, you say the new permit should be in the mail well before then. Once the agent tells you the temporary permit is on file, you thank them and end the call; you do not raise anything else.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The warning must precede the hold and the hold must precede the permit upload (edges); the inspection recording is a parallel prerequisite of the permit only. It commutes with the warning and the hold: its computation reads vehicle, notice, registration and inspection fields that neither of them writes, and they read nothing it writes. Run with the order inspection, warning, hold, permit gave the same values (6, 6, 138, 44) and an identical terminal DB to the gold order warning, hold, inspection, permit.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the inspection recording leaves inspection_expiry_date 2026-10-12 (11 days): two short documents, so the temporary permit accepted_days is 38 instead of 44 (permit expiry 2026-11-08 instead of 2026-11-14), and the inspection expiry stays 2026-10-12 instead of 2027-02-14.

Skipping the hold leaves the agreement active: the temporary permit accepted_days is 49 instead of 44 (permit expiry 2026-11-19), and status/hold fields stay active/none instead of on_hold/document_expired/2026-09-26.
Skipping the warning gives registration grace 13 instead of 6 (hold start 2026-10-03, not yet arrived, instead of 2026-09-26), and the standing record lacks the warning row (sequence 6, 7.4%).

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to put the temporary permit receipt on file. It never names the cancellation warning, the registration hold or the inspection recording and drops no hint that something must be done first; the inspection upload, the registration lapse and the cancellations surface only as answers to direct questions, and his consent is a general 'whatever their rules require'. His reactions to a warning or a hold follow the agent's statements.
